items.title: Moderna Rises 6% Despite GSK Moving Rival mRNA Flu Vaccine to Phase III
items.summary: GSK just handed Moderna's biggest rival program a late-stage green light, yet traders are sending MRNA stock sharply higher. The logic behind that reaction tells you something important about where the real value of mRNA technology sits right now.

items.title: Stock Market Enjoys August Gains—Thanks to Unusual Winners
